title: Staff accounts
subtitle: Who can sign in, and what they can do.
footnote: Passwords and roles can't be changed after an account is created yet.
createdNotice: Created the {role, select, Admin {admin} Seller {seller} other {{role}}} account “{username}”.

dialog.title: Add a staff account
dialog.description: They sign in with this username and password. Share the password with them directly.
dialog.adminHint: Admins can see and change everything, including staff accounts.
dialog.sellerHint: Sellers can scan, sell and look items up. They can't receive stock or reach the back office.

validation.username: Use 3 to 50 characters: letters, digits, . _ or -.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{username}”?
deleteDialog.description: They won't be able to sign in again, and this can't be undone. If they are signed in right now, that session keeps working until it expires, up to 8 hours.
